description: A font whose /Encoding /Differences remaps the glyph names for codes 65/66 (normally A/B) to B/A, with no /ToUnicode CMap -- the same shape a subsetted/CID-keyed embedded font takes when its glyph-name-based Unicode recovery doesn't match the font's own internal glyph order. Stage 1 has no CMap-aware fallback, so extraction recovers the swapped letters.

lines.text: BA swapped by a Differences encoding.

reading_order: AB swapped by a Differences encoding.
